name: Jomsborg Jomsvikings
summary: The legendary Jomsvikings — a mercenary brotherhood whose discipline and dark oaths make them the most feared coven in the North.
lore: Jomsborg's warriors follow a code of blood and silence. They fear nothing, not even death — for their oaths bind them beyond the grave. To take this coven is to command the North's finest.

events.title: The Herring Run Fails
events.narrative: The herring vanish from the Öresund overnight. Fishers gather at the shore, muttering that the old sea-spirits have been offended.

events.title: A Runestone Weeps Blood
events.narrative: An ancient runestone near your village begins to weep red sap. The elders say it is a warning from the old gods.

choiceA.label: Read the runes and heed the warning

choiceB.label: Chip the stone for amulets to sell

events.title: A Frost Giant Stirs
events.narrative: The earth trembles and a vast shape moves in the blizzard. The skalds say a frost giant walks again.

random.winMessage: Your warband drives the giant back into the ice! +8 Followers.
random.lossMessage: The giant scatters your warriors. -5 Followers.

events.title: A Valkyrie Appears
events.narrative: A winged woman lands on the cliff above your village, her armor gleaming. She studies your followers with cold eyes.

choiceA.label: Ask her to bless your warriors

choiceB.label: Offer her a seat at your fire

events.title: Longship Raiders Approach
events.narrative: A dragon-prowed longship appears on the horizon. They are raiders — or perhaps recruits.

random.winMessage: You strike before they land! Their silver is yours. +25% Gold.
random.lossMessage: They were ready. Your raid fails and followers scatter. -4 Followers.

choiceB.label: Parley and offer them a place

events.title: The Long Night
events.narrative: The winter solstice falls over your village. The longest night. Your followers gather around a bonfire on the frozen beach.

events.title: A Berserker Demands Trial
events.narrative: A massive berserker arrives, challenging your authority. His eyes are already turning white with the bear-spirit.

choiceA.label: Fight him in single combat
choiceA.description: +30% Faith if you win, -6 Followers if you lose

random.winMessage: You strike the berserker down! The crowd roars your name. +30% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The berserker's fury is too great. Six followers leave in disgust. -6 Followers.

choiceB.label: Offer him a place as your champion

events.title: A Seiðr Witch Arrives
events.narrative: An old woman with one eye arrives at your village, claiming to walk between worlds. She offers to teach your coven the old ways.

choiceB.label: Turn her away and keep your ways pure

events.title: Odin's Raven Watches
events.narrative: A great raven perches on the roof of your hall for three days. It does not eat, drink, or sleep. It only watches.

choiceB.label: Capture it and use its feathers for charms

events.title: A Drowning in the Sound
events.narrative: A young fisher is pulled from the freezing water, barely alive. He babbles of a city of lights beneath the waves.

choiceB.label: Sell the interpretation to his family
